intro: Technology and government sectors feature prominently across 38 zero-day articles published between 2026-04-12 and 2026-10-14. APT29, Chaotic Eclipse, and Claude Mythos are the most frequently cited threat actors. Among the vulnerabilities covered, CVE-2026-22679 carries the highest CVSS score at 9.8, followed by CVE-2026-108398, CVE-2026-92707, and CVE-2026-96951, each rated 8.8, and CVE-2026-34621 at 8.6. Enterprise, healthcare, and telecommunications also appear among affected sectors, while coverage spans Global, Asia, Brazil, China, and Europe. The severity mix comprises 20 high, 17 critical, and one medium finding.
